tuning.first_fused_draft: regressed large qwen35b workload to about 8.6 ms; rejected
retained: M128 x I128 SwiGLU CTA tasks with last-arrival dGate reduction
packed BF16 pair maxima and row FP8 decoding
K128 cache ownership striped over N tiles
64-block backward waves for more than 128 M blocks
fix Wgrad task-mailbox synchronization for empty experts

limitations: Not uniformly faster than BF16: qwen35b/8192 remains about 24% slower.
Small qwen35b workloads show about 1-3% overhead versus the old FP8 path.
Row-to-column requantization uses decoded row FP8; it can differ from direct BF16 column quantization.
Multi-node GIN retains the legacy cache path and was compile-checked, not runtime-validated.
Results are forward/backward cycles, not optimizer-inclusive training steps.
